Class WidgetBuilder

java.lang.Object
io.github.isoyigido.basic.gui.core.loader.WidgetBuilder
public class WidgetBuilder extends Object

Represents a Builder for widgets.

Required parameters:

  • x: the x-coordinate of the widget anchor point (IntegerParameter)
  • y: the y-coordinate of the widget anchor point (IntegerParameter)
  • anchor: the point on the widget anchored to the coordinates (AnchorParameter)

Optional parameters:

  • show: whether the widget is initially visible (BooleanParameter)
  • layer: the layer index of the widget (IntegerParameter)

    • addRequiredParameter

      protected void addRequiredParameter(String key, Parameter<?> parameter)
      Adds a required parameter. The parameter key can consist of lowercase letters, uppercase letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-).
      Parameters:
      key - the key for the parameter
      parameter - the parameter that is effectively tied to the key
      See Also:
      • Parameter
      API Note:
      Required parameters must have a set value. The buildNewObject() method ensures that every required parameter has a set value before building the object, and returns an empty Optional if any required parameter does not have a set value. Implementations of build() can safely use Parameter.get() on a required parameter without checking if the parameter has a set value.

    • addOptionalParameter

      protected void addOptionalParameter(String key, Parameter<?> parameter)
      Adds an optional parameter. The parameter key can consist of lowercase letters, uppercase letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-).
      Parameters:
      key - the key for the parameter
      parameter - the parameter that is effectively tied to the key
      See Also:
      • Parameter
      API Note:
      Optional parameters may not have a set value. Implementations of build() must use Parameter.getOptional() on optional parameters to get an Optional of the value, or check whether the optional parameter has a value using Parameter.isPresent() before using Parameter.get(). Using Parameter.get() on a parameter that does not have a set value causes an UnsupportedOperationException to be thrown.

    • setParameterValue

      protected void setParameterValue(String key, String valueString)

      Parses the given value string and sets the value of the parameter tied to the given key.

      Special cases:

      • Logs a warning and does nothing if the input key is not tied to any parameter
      Parameters:
      key - the key for the parameter
      valueString - the String representation of the value
      See Also:
      • Parameter

    • buildNewObject

      public Optional<Widget> buildNewObject()

      Builds an object using the stored parameter values.

      Special cases:

      • Logs a warning and returns an empty Optional if any required parameter does not have a set value
      • Returns an empty Optional if build() returns an empty Optional
      Returns:
      an Optional containing the built object, or an empty Optional if any required parameter does not have a set value, or if the provided set of parameter values cannot be used to construct an object
